== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Hindsight]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark the words that changed between neighbouring columns. The Players Committee's forward-reading copy of the D-E1 image (<code>hindsight_readable</code>) is not a column: it is noted on [[Hindsight (PC 2024 D-E1 card)]] (Bill, 25 November 2026). Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.
